purpose: Append-only correction of the Lane-6 Solar source-domain stress test: preserve the unchanged GQNS source-only calculation and every source-boundary failure, withdraw the invalid INPOP constant-acceleration exclusion ratio, repair the pairwise-spread and robustness statements, add independent mechanics/projection checks, and freeze the source-and-solver contract required before any observational residual is opened.

supersedes.scope: decision, published-bound transfer, pairwise-spread label, domain-robustness wording, and critical verification coverage only; v1 remains immutable evidence

corrections.invalid_ratio_reason: The INPOP08 one-quarter-Pioneer result is a postfit detectability statement for a constant-magnitude Sun-directed acceleration applied to outer-planet equations; it is not a pointwise Neptune norm bound for the time-dependent GQNS residual after an algebraic inverse-square projection.
corrections.pairwise_spread_rule: Report every absolute pairwise enhancement difference, their true minimum and maximum, and half the range as the minimax residual in enhancement fraction under a freely chosen common constant.
corrections.domain_robustness_rule: Claim only D05-D06-D07 stability under Moon resolution and the declared asteroid-ring sensitivity; retain D00-D04 and remote-source changes as source-localization failures, never as robustness passes.

reference_source.frame: ICRF/J2000 barycentric geometric states with no aberration correction

dynamical_model.baseline: DE440-compatible barycentric N-body equations: mutual point-mass Newtonian terms, first-post-Newtonian EIH terms, separate Earth and Moon, solar J2, and the same small-body source inventory in baseline and GQNS variants.
dynamical_model.gqns_rule: At every accepted integration epoch recompute the unchanged global A_Q and L from the declared finite source domain, then add the normalized positive Helmholtz-cloud acceleration with exact target self removal and target-minus-reference dynamics.
dynamical_model.small_body_gate: The exact DE440 343-asteroid, 30-KBO, and KBO-ring state/mass manifest must be acquired and SHA-256 sealed before propagation; no response may be opened first.

solver.variational_equations: Integrate the state-transition matrix and parameter partials alongside every baseline and GQNS trajectory.
solver.baseline_admission: Before response access, reproduce held-out DE440 geometric states over the full interval with independently frozen body-specific position/velocity tolerances and demonstrate step-halving convergence.

nuisance_parameters: six Cartesian initial-state components for each fitted planet-system barycenter
separate geocentric lunar initial state where the response requires it
the identical admitted asteroid/ring mass parameters used by the baseline
fit_contract.optimizer: weighted nonlinear least squares using propagated variational partials, identical convergence and outlier policy for baseline and variants
fit_contract.primary_statistic: per-dataset and global weighted postfit RMS degradation relative to the admitted baseline
secondary_statistics: parameter shifts in baseline covariance units

blockers: acquire and SHA-256 seal de440.bsp plus the exact small-body state/mass manifest
implement and hash the baseline/GQNS integrator and variational equations
pass DE440 state replay, conservation, self-force, frame, time-scale, and convergence gates
freeze the exact INPOP-compatible observation-file manifest, row selection, weights, corrections, and licenses without reading values
freeze fitted-parameter priors, outlier policy, dataset partitions, numerical thresholds, and injection-recovery fixtures
obtain explicit authorization before opening any observational response or residual value

may_establish: the exact v1 source-only stress calculation and its large source-domain dependence are preserved
the unchanged point-source GQNS enhancement cannot be exactly absorbed by one common inverse-square constant at unequal radii
D05-D06-D07 are stable to the declared Moon and asteroid-ring source refinements
the prior INPOP ratio and exclusion decision are withdrawn and retained as failures
does_not_establish: an INPOP or DE440 postfit residual result
a valid transfer of the INPOP constant-acceleration threshold to GQNS
a completed or admitted N-body refit solver
